requirements.text: Reduce long queues at the library desk.
Enable students to borrow and return books online.
Allow students to check the availability of books before visiting the library.
Allow students to book study rooms via their mobile devices.
Provide real-time availability of study rooms.
Allow students to select the desired date and time for study room bookings.
Allow students to choose the room based on the number of people it can accommodate.
Implement notifications for due dates to help prevent fines.
Send notifications for due dates to students' mobile phones.
Provide an option for email reminders for due dates.
Allow students to choose their preferred method of receiving reminders.
Provide a user-friendly tool for librarians to easily update and manage the inventory of books and materials.
Allow librarians to track the popularity of items among students.
Enable librarians to generate reports on book borrowing statistics and study room usage frequency.
Create a smoother and more user-friendly experience for students.
